content.text:
Made the agent-shell prompt part of the i18n pipeline:

- [get-started.ts](docs/.vitepress/theme/get-started.ts) — added `agentPrompt` to `GetStartedTabsStrings` and its English default.
- [i18n.ts](docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts) — added the same string to `ENGLISH_UI_STRINGS.getStartedTabs`, so `translate-chrome.ts`'s `flattenStrings` walk picks it up automatically for every locale.
- [GetStartedTabs.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/GetStartedTabs.vue) — dropped the hardcoded `AGENT_PROMPT` constant; the agent cycle's suffix now reads `getStartedTabs.value.agentPrompt` reactively via a computed, so it re-renders in the active locale's translation.

Added a changeset. Run `node scripts/translate-chrome.ts` (with the AI adapter env vars) to populate per-locale translations for the new string.
